verdict.rationale: The docs explicitly claim that an agent can do everything on Lium without a browser: sign up, fund, rent, connect and remove pods. This is backed by a live OpenAPI 3.1 schema, scoped API keys, and CLI and SDK coverage of pods and clusters. The 404 probe tested docs.lium.io paths, not the documented lium.io/api/openapi.json, so it does not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of parity, and evidence that UI-documented features such as volume COST HISTORY and the Confidential Computing filter in Browse Pods are also exposed via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: An agent can do everything on Lium with no browser: sign up, fund, rent, connect and remove pods.
The Lium platform API publishes a live [OpenAPI 3.1](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.0) schema.
fingerprint signup: one call to `POST /auth/signup`, no email, no password, no confirmation link.
From the terminal: `lium clusters up <fabric> --nodes N --name <name>`
